workflow.content:
name: HIA NDU feedback mechanism gates (research)

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/hia-ndu-feedback.yml'
      - 'experiments/hia_ndu_feedback_20261106/**'
      - 'benchmarks/hia_ndu_feedback/**'
      - 'benchmarks/hia_ndu_feedback_state_coverage/**'
      - 'rust/hia-ndu-value/**'
      - 'tests/test_hia_ndu_feedback.py'
      - 'tests/test_hia_ndu_feedback_workload.py'
      - 'tests/test_hia_ndu_feedback_campaign.py'
      - 'tests/test_hia_ndu_feedback_coverage.py'
      - 'tests/test_hia_ndu_economical.py'
      - 'tests/test_hia_ndu_compute_price.py'
      - 'tools/build_hia_ndu_value_bridge.py'
      - 'tools/qualify_hia_ndu_feedback.py'
      - 'tools/qualify_hia_ndu_compute_price.py'
      - 'docs/HIA_NDU_NATIVE_VALUE.md'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  reference-and-native:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
      GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: '0'
      EXPECTED_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Freeze clean source before evaluation
        id: source_identity
        run: |
          feedback_actual_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          printf 'actual_head=%s\n' "$feedback_actual_head" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          python -B -m experiments.hia_ndu_feedback_20261106.ci snapshot \
            --expected-head "$EXPECTED_SOURCE_HEAD" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-ndu-feedback/public/source-before.json"
      - name: Require rejection of wrong heads and same-tree synthetic merges
        run: |
          python -B -m experiments.hia_ndu_feedback_20261106.ci guard-controls \
            --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-ndu-feedback/public"
      - name: Require mechanism, price, campaign and source-boundary tests with zero skips
        run: |
          python -B -m experiments.hia_ndu_feedback_20261106.ci reference \
            --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-ndu-feedback/public"
      - name: Acquire pinned original source and build both native adapters
        run: |
          # Anonymous, exact-commit Git fetch follows existing NDU workflows.
          # No extra token/secret, permission widening or fallback evaluator.
          # An inaccessible upstream fails this gate and leaves an OPEN receipt.
          python -B -m experiments.hia_ndu_feedback_20261106.ci prepare \
            --scratch "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-ndu-feedback/private" \
            --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-ndu-feedback/public"
      - name: Require native tests, reversals, degeneration and actual execution
        run: |
          python -B -m experiments.hia_ndu_feedback_20261106.ci native \
            --config "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-ndu-feedback/private/native-config.json" \
            --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-ndu-feedback/public"
      - name: Verify identical clean source after success or failure
        if: always()
        run: |
          python -B -m experiments.hia_ndu_feedback_20261106.ci snapshot \
            --expected-head "$EXPECTED_SOURCE_HEAD" \
            --before "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-ndu-feedback/public/source-before.json" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-ndu-feedback/public/source-after.json"
      - name: Stage only the explicit public evidence allowlist
        if: always()
        run: |
          python -B -m experiments.hia_ndu_feedback_20261106.ci publish \
            --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-ndu-feedback/public" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-ndu-feedback/upload"
      - name: Retain receipts and protocol frames, including failures
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: hia-ndu-feedback-${{ steps.source_identity.outputs.actual_head || 'unobserved-head' }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-ndu-feedback/upload/

pull_request_metadata.body:
## Problem

Round 6's unit-discount linear cost experiment correctly tied after ordinary planning. That experiment cannot distinguish numeric preference wiring, feedback modeling, solver error, and runtime costs.

## Changes

- Preserve the degeneration control and add hand-calculated non-dominated action reversals.
- Use unchanged source-pinned native NDU at every Bellman decision backup, before action selection, with explicit eligible abstention.
- Add an immutable observed-state interface, hidden future request generation, a physical one-slot native cache executor, and complete partial-failure/cleanup cost records.
- Compare fixed, state-greedy, ordinary MPC, same-objective, fixed-preference NDU, dynamic NDU, and an independently encoded exact oracle. Add a bounded compute gate.
- Freeze three environments and 288 primary cells, retain all model/real-workload observations and every failed denominator, and diagnose deliberate model errors separately.
- Add independent adversarial tests and a native CI workflow that fails if original-source access or native execution is unavailable.

## Validation status

Implementation source: b1746d3e436f001ea5c69d154d766fadf7231136; tree 92f3241ee7b5452d49947129a3a462765ada034e.

Development reference tests: 63/63. Existing source-closure/dynamic-cache regressions: 32/32. Original native value differential controls and causal integration ran successfully; frozen final campaign is running and will be attached separately.

This PR remains Draft. Research authority is DENY_ALL. No production activation, FBSDE/gradient-training claim, or independent net-gain claim is made from wiring success. Raw final results, including any negative benefit, will determine the acceptance status.
